messages:
maya: Heads-up — we need a workspace-scoped view for token-level latency + KV cache hit ratio in Grafana. Current dashboards only show global aggregates and it's hiding tenant regressions.

sam: +1. Are we comfortable adding workspace_id labels to token_latency_bucket? cardinality could blow up.

jon: We should avoid raw per-tenant histogram churn. Option: record per-workspace aggregates via recording rules for top-N tenants and keep raw high-cardinality metrics in long-term storage only. Also derive "workspace_token_latency_p95" as a gauge.

maya: The panel should let us toggle between global / workspace and also by route_id. Support needs RBAC so they only see their customer's workspace. @akshay any constraints?

akshay: Dashboard folder perms + data-source scoping is the easiest. Two approaches: (1) use Grafana folder + team permissions + SSO group mapping, (2) create tenant-scoped Prometheus remote_read endpoints that filter by workspace_id. First is faster, second is safer for multi-tenant isolation.

claire: Panels we need: p50/p95/p99 token latency, kernel_exec time, kv_lookup time, and kv_cache_hit_ratio by workspace. Metric examples: `token_latency_bucket`, `kernel_exec_seconds`, `kv_lookup_seconds`, `kv_cache_hits_total` / `kv_cache_requests_total`.

observability-bot: note: staging has `token_latency_bucket{workspace_id,route_id,model_variant}` instrumented. Example test query: `sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le,workspace_id)` — verify cardinality before prod.

sam: PromQL for per-workspace p95 (raw): `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le,workspace_id,route_id))`. But on 1000s of routes this will be slow. Use `topk(50, ...)` to limit.

jon: Recording rule idea: `- record: workspace:token_latency_p95:rate5m\n  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le,workspace_id,route_id))`\nThis yields one timeseries per (workspace,route) only when active in topk pipeline.

maya: Rollout plan: pilot with 5 tenants (Customer-A, B, C, internal-test1, internal-test2). We'll enable workspace labels for pilot and create dashboards.

akshay: Security checklist: folder "Customer Dashboards" with subfolders per workspace, view-only for support via LDAP groups (e.g., support-customer-a). For edit we gate to eng-platform and obs-team. Also add panel-level variable `workspace_id` with a dropdown.

claire: For token-level breakdown we want a waterfall-like panel: tokenization + routing + kv_lookup + kernel_exec. Need these spans emitted: `tokenization_seconds`, `routing_seconds`, `kv_lookup_seconds`, `kernel_exec_seconds`. Any missing instrumentation?

sam: runtime already emits kernel_exec and kv_lookup spans. We'll add tokenization and routing spans this sprint (perf-instr-221). Also tag spans with `workspace_id` and `route_id`.

maya: Cost/perf note: recording rules + extra metrics increase TS cardinality and remote_write costs. Proposed mitigation: 7d retention for workspace-level high-card metrics, and keep long-term aggregated rollups (per-model, per-region) for >7d.

jon: Agreed. Also consider pre-aggregating KV cache hit ratio as `workspace:kv_cache_hit:ratio` via `sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) by (workspace_id)` / `sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])) by (workspace_id)`. Saves expensive on-the-fly joins.

maya: akshay please own RBAC plan and file any infra tickets. sam/jon please prototype recording rules and a Grafana dashboard with sample pilot tenants.

observability-bot: created OBS-482: "Workspace-scoped latency dashboards + RBAC" assigned to @akshay, link https://redwood.atlassian/OBS-482

akshay: Filed IAM ticket for SSO group mapping and folder perms. Assigning to infra-sre.

sam: I'll drop a sample dashboard JSON in the obs-scratch repo tonight with recording-rule YAML and PromQL examples.

jon: Watch out: some Prometheus instances we query are older and don't support external_labels filtering — we may need to do relabel_configs on scrape to add workspace_id consistently.

maya: Thanks all. Sync tomorrow 10:00am to review queries and pilot list. :thumbsup:
